{{Quote|House Syrush has been gone a year, but the Killiks who took over their estate are busy, busy.|Elz Organa|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''House Syrush''' was one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A vassal house of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], the house fell to the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] in [[3644 BBY]] and was absorbed into the hive-mind, but some members of the house were kept as prisoners, and the Killiks took over the Syrush estate.
